content: Omri natuna Aheb na Yawe God matene na bera bero kirakiidi ibera, geware kiikiiwawo tupadi mekodi naghone sivibadana naboni.

Touna inoghosi da wiitamumu na getana awaki, ware Nebet natuna Jeroboam tamumu iberana naboni. Bi bera bero kirakiina ibera na Saidon damdi yadi kiiwawo Eetbaal natuna wasike Jesibel irawayi bi Baal iyapeepeteni.
Aheb kabepepa barena tana Baal kiiravine Sameriya kwanatune iyoghani da suwara gabugabuna gawarina kamone ibera.
Bi kate bada god wasikena Asera
kabepepina kiiravine kana kiitupo ikabiwiimiiri. Aheb bera peyaridi ibera da Yawe, Isrel kana God ivinuwapughupughuni, geware kiikiiwawo naghone sivibadana naboni.

footnotes.text: Asera touna god wasikena bi Mesapotemiya, Ijipt, Ponisiya da Siriya damdi yadi god tana Baal wavinena.
